summary: One-frame request from the mod browser GUI to fill the three mod.io caches (client only, registry total 288): read by ModInfoCachedRequestSystem (sets +0/+0x30, bg3.exe+0x3BE8B10 component stride 0x120), ModDependencyCachedRequestSystem (sets +0x60/+0x90, bg3.exe+0x3BE3780) and ModListCachedRequestSystem (sets +0xC0/+0xF0, bg3.exe+0x3BED490). In each pair the first set is always requested and the second is filtered against the cache.

fields.name: ModId
fields.evidence: Windows HashSet<ls::ugc::ModItemInfoID> insert bg3.exe+0x126FEA0 hashes the qword at +0 and the find bg3.exe+0x12705B0 compares it first (key stride 0x20); macOS ModInfoCachedRequestSystemHelper::RequestItemInfo(unsigned long long, Optional<Version>, bool, EHardwareType) takes the members in this order (mod id first).

fields.name: Version
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x126FEA0 hashes +8 only when the byte at +0x10 is set, and bg3.exe+0x12705B0 compares +8 only when both +0x10 bytes are set: the value of an optional (macOS Ensure<ModItemInfoID> identical) - the Optional<Version> argument.

fields.name: HasVersion
fields.evidence: has-value flag of the optional at +8 (bg3.exe+0x126FEA0 / bg3.exe+0x12705B0).

fields.name: HardwareType
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x126FEA0 hashes the int at +0x1C and bg3.exe+0x12705B0 compares it: the EHardwareType argument of RequestItemInfo by order (enum not declared in Script Extender; 4 bytes).

fields.name: ModId
fields.evidence: ls::ugc::ModItemDependenciesInfoID, 16 bytes (Windows key stride 0x10 in bg3.exe+0x3BE3780 / bg3.exe+0x3BE4ED0); macOS HashTable<ModItemDependenciesInfoID>::Ensure (bg3_macos_x64+0x2B60DB0) hashes the qword at +0 and compares it first; RequestItemDependencies(unsigned long long, bool) names it as the mod id.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: macOS Ensure compares one byte at +8 (the bool argument of RequestItemDependencies). Windows bg3.exe+0x3BE4ED0 hashes and compares the key with the generic 16-byte ops (k[0] ^ k[1], FUN_1405CA2A0), which reads +8 as a whole qword: the byte width rests on macOS.

fields.name: _Pad9
fields.evidence: padding (compared as part of a qword by the Windows 16-byte key ops)

second_pass: All three key structs now come from Windows code (ModItemInfoID: insert bg3.exe+0x126FEA0 / find bg3.exe+0x12705B0; ModItemListInfoID: copy bg3.exe+0x127F540 / equality bg3.exe+0x15F83E0 / hash bg3.exe+0x127EB60); macOS ~CacheRequestGUIModOneFrameComponent confirms the set types at +0/+0x30 (ModItemInfoID), +0x60/+0x90 (ModItemDependenciesInfoID), +0xC0/+0xF0 (ModItemListInfoID). Only the width of the dependency id's flag rests on macOS.
